name: @agentine/folio
description: Replaces exceljs — Excel workbook manager for Node.js with full styling support. Read/write .xlsx and .csv with rich formatting (fonts, borders, fills, alignment), data validation, conditional formatting, images, tables, streaming. TypeScript-first, zero deps, ESM+CJS (~4.4M weekly npm downloads, 2,264 dependents, unmaintained 2.5+ years, 784 open issues)

scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs
